members.name: value
members.doc: The slider's color, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The starting color, when the slider controls itself.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the new color as a CSS string each time the channel changes. It is in the slider's color space when colorSpace is set, and otherwise in the space of the value, the enclosing ColorPicker, or defaultValue. A disabled or read-only slider does not call it.

members.name: channel
members.doc: The channel the slider adjusts. It must belong to colorSpace or, without colorSpace, to the space of the enclosing ColorPicker's color, otherwise of value or defaultValue; any other pair throws a TypeError.

members.name: colorSpace
members.doc: The color space the slider reads and reports in. Without it the slider uses the enclosing ColorPicker's space, otherwise the space of the value.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the slider: it can be neither focused nor changed. A disabled enclosing ColorPicker disables it too.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the slider read-only: it stays focusable but its channel cannot be changed. A read-only enclosing ColorPicker does the same.

types.name: ColorSliderOwnProps

members.name: label
members.doc: The visible label, which also names the slider. Without one, the slider needs an aria-label or aria-labelledby, and an empty label does not count.
